title: Reviewer calibration panel
description: Review the same manuscript blind against a shared rubric, then let a teacher model critique the reviewers until their standards agree enough to decide on.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-peer-01
  title: Reviewer calibration panel
  description: Review the same manuscript blind against a shared rubric, then let a teacher model critique
    the reviewers until their standards agree enough to decide on.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a review set where reviewers applied the same standard, disagreements are substantive
    rather than definitional, and the editor can weigh them honestly.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Manuscript and review rubric
      summary: Manuscript and review rubric
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - manuscript
              - review_rubric
              - supplementary_materials
              - agreement_threshold
            properties:
              manuscript: {}
              review_rubric: {}
              supplementary_materials: {}
              agreement_threshold: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-assess1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: peer-03
      name: Methods and statistics review
      summary: Blind assessment 1; no sight of the other assessments.
      role: Reviewer testing whether the methods support the claims made.
      prompt: You are a Methods & Statistics Reviewer. You test whether the design, analysis, and reported
        statistics support the paper's claims, checking pre-registration conformance, multiplicity, power,
        and whether the effect size means anything practically. You state which claims the data do support,
        because a review that only lists faults leaves the editor without a decision.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - geospatial-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-assess2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: peer-04
      name: Reproducibility review
      summary: Blind assessment 2; no sight of the other assessments.
      role: Analyst testing whether the reported result can actually be regenerated.
      prompt: You are a Reproducibility Analyst. You test whether the data, code, and environment provided
        regenerate the reported figures and tables, and you record exactly where the attempt failed. You
        distinguish 'not reproducible from what was provided' from 'wrong', because those require different
        editorial responses and conflating them is unfair to authors.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - scientific-analysis
          - evaluation
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:repository
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-assess3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: peer-05
      name: Integrity and citation review
      summary: Blind assessment 3; no sight of the other assessments.
      role: Screener checking images, text, and citations for integrity problems.
      prompt: You are a Research Integrity Screener. You screen for image manipulation and duplication,
        text overlap, citation integrity, and undisclosed conflicts, and you report observations rather
        than allegations, with the exact location of each. You distinguish an artifact of processing from
        evidence of manipulation, because the cost of a wrong integrity claim to an author's career is
        severe and often permanent.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
          - decision-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:editorial-system
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-panel
      kind: group
      name: Blind review panel
      summary: Every assessor runs on the same evidence in parallel; the group exits only once every member
        result has been serialized into the declared order.
      config:
        members:
          - n-assess1
          - n-assess2
          - n-assess3
        execution: parallel
        exit: serialize
    - id: n-teacher
      kind: teacher
      inlineRole: true
      name: Rubric calibration
      summary: Critique the assessors against the rubric — this scores the graders, not the work.
      role: Host-resolved teacher model
      prompt: 'You are the calibration teacher for this review panel. Critique the reviewers against the
        rubric: where did two reviewers apply different standards to the same section, which criticisms
        are preferences stated as requirements, and which rubric criteria are too vague to apply consistently?
        Return reviewer-level feedback. Score the reviewers, not the manuscript.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
      config:
        teacherModel: host:teacher-model
        feedbackMode: rubric
    - id: n-agreement
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score inter-assessor agreement
      summary: Evaluate inter-reviewer agreement per rubric criterion and evidence behind each criticism.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against inter-reviewer agreement per rubric criterion and evidence
        behind each criticism. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind the verdict, remaining
        uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic measurement unless
        the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n-calibrated
      kind: condition
      name: Calibrated?
      summary: Route on agreement.passed.
      config:
        expression: agreement.passed
        branches:
          - label: Calibrated
            when: 'true'
          - label: Not calibrated
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-recalibrate
      kind: loop
      name: Recalibrate until assessors agree
      summary: Repeat a bounded revision sequence until inter-assessor agreement meets the declared threshold.
      config:
        body:
          - n-panel
          - n-teacher
          - n-agreement
          - n-calibrated
        exitCondition: inter-assessor agreement meets the declared threshold
        maxIterations: 3
        onExhausted: stop
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Handling editor accepts the calibrated review set
      summary: Pause for the handling editor; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Reviewer calibration panel deliverable, the evidence behind it, and
        every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-peer-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-panel
      kind: data
    - id: wf-peer-01-edge-2
      from: n-panel
      to: n-teacher
      kind: data
    - id: wf-peer-01-edge-3
      from: n-teacher
      to: n-agreement
      kind: data
    - id: wf-peer-01-edge-4
      from: n-agreement
      to: n-calibrated
      kind: data
    - id: wf-peer-01-edge-5
      from: n-calibrated
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-peer-01-edge-6
      from: n-calibrated
      to: n-recalibrate
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-peer-01-edge-7
      from: n-recalibrate
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: wf-peer-01-edge-8
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
